cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je rozvoj komunikativní kompetence v anglickém jazyce na úrovni B2 se zaměřením na mluvený projev a aktivní používání jazyka v běžných a společenských situacích. Student je schopen vyjádřit vlastní názor, porozumět spontánnímu projevu, zapojovat se do diskuze a pracovat s náročnějšími texty. Současně si prohlubuje znalosti vybraných gramatických struktur odpovídajících úrovni B2.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the subject is to develop students’ communicative competence in English at the B2 level, with a focus on speaking and active language use. Students develop the ability to express their opinions, understand spontaneous speech, participate in discussions, and work with more demanding texts, while deepening their knowledge of selected grammatical structures appropriate to the B2 level.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Work, personality (allowance 0/4) a.question creation, indirect questions, auxiliary verbs, comparative adjectivesb.the world of work, job interview, personality descriptionc.leading of discussion of various topics, telling a story and reactions to unusual reports2.Health (allowance 0/4) a.present perfect simple and continuous, adjectives, adjectives as nouns, order of adjectivesb.illnesses and injuries – nouns, adjectives and phrasal verbsc.illnesses and injuries, going to the doctor3.Travel (allowance 0/4) a.narrative tenses: past simple and continuous, past perfect simple and continuous, phrases with so…, such…thatb.travel – air transportation – nouns and adjectives, difference between travel, trip and journey, phrasal verbs4.Natural environment (allowance 0/2) a.expressing the future, zero and first conditionals, future time clauses5.Assumptions and wishes (allowance 0/4) a.2nd conditional, wishing sentences (wish)b.adjectives expressing feelings, extreme adjectives and informal and slang expressionsc.feelings, expressing assumptions, sharing of feelings and wishes6.Feelings (allowance 0/2) a.gerunds and infinitives – verbal expressions, used to, be used to, get used to7.Relationships between people, human body (allowance 0/4) a.modal verbs in the past: must, might/may, should, can’t, couldn’t+have, etc.; would rather, verbs for the sensesb.false friends, words that are often confused, e.g.. notice/realize, raise/rise, remember/remind8.Criminality (allowance 0/2) a.the passive, including it is said that…, he is thought to…; the expression have something doneb.crime and criminals – crimes, verbs and criminals, court trials, administrative awareness9.Revision (allowance 0/2)
